run_transform_on_graph: run a Transform subclass on a torch.fx.GraphModule to apply FX graph transformations
create_package_info_from_class: create a PackageInfo dataclass from a Python class to extract package name, version, and commit hash
generate_graph_diff: generate a unified diff string comparing old and new FX graph representations
analyze_fx_graph_module: analyze a torch.fx.GraphModule using an Analysis subclass with diagnostic context and ONNX function dispatcher
get_tabular_graph_output: get a torch.fx.Graph printed in tabular format for readable inspection
